implementation_decisions.title: 공통 호출 규약
implementation_decisions.selection: Python 3.12 Protocol + JSON object at in-process service boundary; provider bridges may use async or other internal transport; I4 only called by accepted worker
alternatives: Framework model types as shared canonical schema
implementation_decisions.reason: Current isolated Python bootstrap passed, common types are JSON and physical separation not required. Minimal provider contracts avoid mandatory framework or distributed infrastructure.
implementation_decisions.revisit_when: Provider requires process isolation, streaming or latency constraints.
implementation_decisions.pending_review: R02/R03/R05 confirm concrete provider signatures/transport; change only by shared review.

implementation_decisions.title: 공통 스키마 검사
implementation_decisions.selection: Use pinned named Draft 2020-12 schema with explicit profile schema; product server uses common contracts/validation.py (jsonschema 4.25.1 pinned in product lock); no second authoritative schema engine. Module error mapping and business guards remain local.
implementation_decisions.reason: Standards-based validation avoids drift; replay agreement is not general equivalence. Product lock supplied by PD-02; standard server validator reuse is default.
implementation_decisions.revisit_when: Missing schema constraints, incompatible profile or performance need.
implementation_decisions.pending_review: R03 and other server providers confirm shared validator integration; any alternative engine needs evidence, divergence tests and R01 review. See HRESP-20261125-04. Frontend UX checks are not server authority.

actual_evidence.limit: 선정 합성 payload 검사. 당시 제품 lock 별도였으며 현재 PD-02 초기 lock 제공; 실제 provider 적용 미검증. 프런트에 Python 엔진 강제 아님.

implementation_decisions.title: Storage·Runtime·Adapter 권한 경계
implementation_decisions.selection: Split store coordinator/gateway capabilities; runtime owns opaque context/permit; adapter gets bound gateway only; no actual permit stub
implementation_decisions.reason: Retain logical owner/atomicity and deny bypass; actual registry/lease implementation remains provider responsibility.
implementation_decisions.revisit_when: Real implementation cannot enforce atomic guard or adapter needs additional typed operation.
implementation_decisions.pending_review: R03/R05 confirm storage transaction signatures, fence/finalize return, adapter registry and operation binding.

actual_evidence.limit: 입력 및 인증 관계 일부만 검증. 실제 원자성·permit·lease·권한 검증 아님
